anchor_comparisons: Current evidence is stronger than the counter anchor midpoint of 11.52 because it includes observed 2026-Q1 memory revenue, growth and operating-profit contribution rather than only an unsupported component score.
Current evidence does not fully reach the positive anchor midpoint of 14.88 because HBM-specific profit and margin and company-level FCF remain forecasts, with explicit attribution and duration gaps.
disagreements: The analyst range is optimistic on duration because it leans on OPEN HBM profit and company FCF forecasts.
The skeptic range is somewhat narrow because it discounts the already observed memory revenue and profit bridge too heavily.
payload.rationale: On the 24-point component scale, the current record belongs between the two ordinal anchors. Actual memory earnings strength and product-mix pricing justify moving above the counter band, but HBM-only cash conversion is absent and important support remains forecast-based. A centered value near the top of the counter band and below the positive midpoint preserves both current strength and uncertainty.
payload.why_not_higher: Calibration cannot move into the middle of the positive anchor band without HBM-only actual economics and evidence that pricing and EPS revisions remain durable.
payload.why_not_lower: Calibration should remain above the counter anchor midpoint because current actual memory revenue, growth and operating profit materially exceed a prose-only or ungrounded counter profile.
